name: Scheduled Task Creation via schtasks.exe
description: Detects use of schtasks.exe with /create to register a new scheduled task, a common persistence mechanism. High-signal when combined with an unusual parent process or a task action pointing at a script interpreter. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_win_schtasks_persistence.yml, compiled from Sigma via sigma-cli (eql, ecs_windows pipeline).
false_positives: Legitimate software installers registering maintenance or update tasks
author: Sentinel
